- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant created a one-shot titled "The Lost Temple of the Djinn."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The backstory of the one-shot includes a powerful Djinn named Zoltar who ruled over a temple filled with treasures and magical artifacts, which was lost to time after his disappearance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A wealthy collector hires the party to retrieve an artifact from the lost temple.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The temple is filled with mummies, undead warriors, and constructs guarding its treasures.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Stat blocks for enemies:
  - Mummies (4):
    - Armor Class: 11
    - Hit Points: 45 (6d8 + 18)
    - Speed: 20 ft.
    - Damage Immunity: Poison, Psychic
    - Condition Immunity: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
    - Traits: 
      - Curse of the Pharaohs: DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to avoid being cursed.
      - Mummy Rot: DC 15 Constitution saving throw to avoid disease.
  - Construct Guardians (2):
    - Armor Class: 17 (natural armor)
    - Hit Points: 110 (13d10 + 30)
    - Speed: 30 ft.
    - Damage Immunity: Poison, Psychic
    - Condition Immunity: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
    - Traits:
      - Immutable Form: Immune to effects that alter its form.
      - Magic Resistance: Advantage on saving throws against spells.
      - Magic Weapons: Weapon attacks are magical.
      - Siege Monster: Deals double damage to objects.
  - Skeletal Warriors (6):
    - Armor Class: 12
    - Hit Points: 22 (5d8)
    - Speed: 30 ft.
    - Damage Immunity: Poison, Psychic
    - Condition Immunity: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
    - Traits:
      - Undead Fortitude: Constitution saving throw to avoid dropping to 0 hit points.
